prose: Mike Brancatelli is the host of Mikeadelic, a podcast about the many uses and philosophies connecting psychedelic plant medicine traditions throughout our realm. In this episode, we get trippy and talk about what a healthy relationship with plant medicine looks like, as opposed to the drug-culture created by the toxic modern pharmacopeia. It's a real face-melter, so tuck that ego into bed and kiss it goodnight as we explore the forbidden reaches of our selves.
ext: We discuss how psychedelics can help one recognize and overcome fear, share thoughts on the totalitarian travesties of 2020, dip into the delicious symbolism of Dune, contemplate the slavery status of US citizenship, and interrogate the mysteries of the imagination.
